title: Globally filtered clone occurrence
statement: Let $E$ be a weighted constraint experiment with template $\Psi$ and variables $V$, and let $R$ be a uniform refinement. Given natural numbers $r,M$ such that every outcome's predicate has arity at most $r$, a globally filtered clone occurrence is a padded clone occurrence for which the map from predicate positions to original-variable and clone-index pairs is injective.
